## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/mcp_server.py:20-42` re-exports 21 output model names solely for old private Python imports; MCP tool names, JSON Schema, outputSchema, and wire payloads are unaffected. Test-only `_is_transient_add_error` aliases in event append/commit modules forward to `gitutil._is_transient_object_write_error`; `_referencing_commit_exists` re-exports/wrapper forward to `_referencing_commits`.

The governing ADR is earthen-wheat-chick [rebar:earthen-wheat-chick].

## Approach

After the ADR merges, migrate every source/test/string/dynamic/monkeypatch consumer to `rebar._mcp_models`, `gitutil._is_transient_object_write_error`, and `_referencing_commits`. Delete the re-exports, wrappers, mock setup, inventories, and stale comments. Preserve MCP wire schemas and end-to-end retry, corruption, post-ref, descendant-credit, and absence-blocking controls.

## Scope

- `mcp_server` output-model imports/`__all__` and model consumers
- event commit/append aliases and classification tests
- close-precheck/transition-close wrappers and lifecycle tests

## Testing

Verify all MCP schemas/wire outputs remain unchanged; test transient object-write classification plus end-to-end retry/corruption/post-ref controls; test descendant credit and missing referencing-commit blocking.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All 21 `mcp_server` output-model re-exports and private-import consumers are removed/migrated to `_mcp_models`.
- [x] MCP tool names, JSON Schema, outputSchema, and wire payloads are unchanged.
- [x] Old transient-error aliases are absent while retry, corruption, and post-ref negative controls pass.
- [x] Old referencing-commit wrappers are absent while descendant-credit and absence-blocking close behavior pass.
- [x] Static, string, dynamic-import, and monkeypatch census proves each removed name/path has no consumer.
